messages.subject: aligning multiple plots
parts:
Hi I am trying to create a multiplot (2 rows and 2 columns) view. I am
able to get all the figures placed properly in different cells. In
total, there are three plots that goes in (1,1), (1,2), and (2,2).
Basically its a 2D plot (place in 1,1) whose x and y axis are
categories and I am showing there percentage frequency on (1,1) and
(2,2). Below are some of my problems

1. My problem is how I can get x axis of the main plot to align with
the axis of (2,2) plot and the y axis of the main plot align with the
axis of (1,1) plot.
2. The plot on (1,1) is a bar plot and I use coord_flip() to draw it
horizontally. However, the y axis is drawn on the left side. I would
like to change it to the y axis.
3. Similar to 2, I would like to change the axis in such a way that
the bars are drawn downwards i.e. move the x-axis to the top.


I will appreciate any help

Ritesh
